log.provenance: Reconstructed verbatim by concatenating exec_command output chunk 914376 and write_stdin output chunk 934c07. These tool outputs were returned by the one test run; no rerun was performed to obtain a log.

hashCaptureNote: Hashes captured after the completed run, not atomically at process start; product files are shared with the parent. Treat them as the subsequent source inspection checkpoint. No timing/performance claim is made.
scope: Protocol fixtures and in-memory task stores only; no browser/service/live task database access.
Distinct receipts batch per session; repeated references deduplicated; preserves order.
Partial, reordered, foreign and throwing batch responses fail closed without single fallback.
Mismatched action value hash and authority flags rejected.
Conflicting same-ID facts rejected within the input batch.
Unknown and revoked receipts re-read on an independent query.
Old hosts remain lazy during prepare and unrelated audit queries.
Unknown or missing source obligations remain unresolved and are not pre-queried.
A remains uncovered when only B has valid receipt evidence.
Runtime plan output matches single-query path; three distinct receipt calls become one batch.
New receipt single gate rejection performs zero old receipt condition queries.
limitations: Synthetic protocol/plan fixtures, not evidence of real webpage recovery or exhaustion.
No end-to-end speed or memory/storage improvement measurement.
SDK batch behavior is validated separately by the SDK test owner.
